# mtncloud_mos_object_acl (Resource)

Who may read one object in a MOS bucket, as a canned ACL, for example to publish one file. Destroy sets it back to `private`. Uploading new content with `mtncloud_mos_object` keeps it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "site" {
  name = "acme-website"
}

resource "mtncloud_mos_object" "logo" {
  bucket = mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.name
  key    = "logo.png"
  source = "${path.module}/logo.png"
}

# Anyone may download this one file.
resource "mtncloud_mos_object_acl" "logo" {
  bucket = mtncloud_mos_object.logo.bucket
  key    = mtncloud_mos_object.logo.key
  acl    = "public-read"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `acl` (String) `private`, `public-read` (anyone may download it), `public-read-write` or `authenticated-read` (any MOS user may).
- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name.
- `key` (String) The object's name.

### Read-Only

- `grants` (List of String) The grants MOS holds, as `<grantee>:<permission>`.
- `id` (String) `<bucket>/<key>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_mos_object_acl.logo acme-website/logo.png
```
